# Define probe names and groups
```{r}
probe_map <- read.csv(file.path(scripts_path, "probe_lists/probe_map_bacteria.csv"), header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

probe_map$Name <- gsub("_", "-", probe_map$Name)
probe_map$List <- gsub("_", "-", probe_map$List)
probe_map <- probe_map[probe_map$Name != "Streptococcaceae-probe10", ]
custom_probes <- probe_map$Name[!grepl("GAPDH", probe_map$Name, ignore.case = TRUE)]
```

# Integration
```{r}
pcs=50
dims=30
hvg=5000
res=0.2

obj_list_micro <- list(
  DLS_CRC_03_norm_QC,
  DLS_CRC_03_tumor_QC,
  DLS_CRC_06_norm_QC,
  DLS_CRC_07_tumor_QC,
  DLS_CRC_08_norm_QC,
  DLS_CRC_08_tumor_QC
)

obj_list_micro <- lapply(obj_list_micro, function(obj) {
  SCTransform(obj, assay = "Spatial", return.only.var.genes = FALSE, verbose = FALSE)
})
features <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(object.list = obj_list_micro, nfeatures = hvg)

visium_merged_micro <- merge(x = obj_list_micro[[1]], y = obj_list_micro[2:6], merge.data = TRUE)

names(visium_merged_micro@images) <- c("CRC_03_Normal", "CRC_03_Tumor", "CRC_06_Normal", "CRC_07_Tumor", "CRC_08_Normal", "CRC_08_Tumor")

VariableFeatures(visium_merged_micro) <- features

visium_merged_micro <- RunPCA(
  visium_merged_micro,
  assay    = "SCT",
  features = features,
  npcs     = pcs,
  verbose  = FALSE
)

visium_merged_micro <- IntegrateLayers(
  visium_merged_micro,
  HarmonyIntegration,
  orig.reduction = "pca",
  new.reduction  = "harmony",
  group.by.vars  = "sample"
)

visium_merged_micro <- FindNeighbors(visium_merged_micro, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:dims)
visium_merged_micro <- FindClusters(visium_merged_micro, resolution = res)
visium_merged_micro <- RunUMAP(visium_merged_micro, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:dims, verbose = FALSE)

DimPlot(visium_merged_micro, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, label.box = TRUE) +
  scale_color_tableau(palette = "Tableau 20") +
  scale_fill_tableau(palette = "Tableau 20") +
  theme_classic()

DimPlot(visium_merged_micro, reduction = "umap", group.by = "sample") +
  scale_color_tableau(palette = "Tableau 20") +
  theme_classic()
```

# Cluster sample distribution (Fig 2b)
```{r}
sample_cluster <- obj@meta.data %>%
  group_by(seurat_clusters, sample) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = 'drop')

ggplot(sample_cluster, aes(x = seurat_clusters, y = n, fill = sample)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
  scale_fill_tableau(palette = "Tableau 20") +
  theme_classic() +
  xlab("Cluster") +
  ylab("Number of Spots")
```

# Differential Expression
```{r}
all_features <- rownames(obj[["SCT"]])

VariableFeatures(obj) <- all_features
obj <- GetResidual(obj, features = VariableFeatures(obj))
obj <- PrepSCTFindMarkers(obj)
markers <- FindAllMarkers(obj, assay = "SCT", only.pos = TRUE)
```

```{r}
markers_ordered <- markers %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  arrange(desc(avg_log2FC), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  ungroup()

markers_top10_log2FC <- markers %>%
  filter(avg_log2FC >= 0.5) %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = avg_log2FC, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()


markers_top10_pct10 <- markers %>%
  filter(p_val_adj < 0.05, pct.1 >= 0.1, avg_log2FC >= 0.5) %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = avg_log2FC, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
obj <- NormalizeData(obj, assay = "Spatial")
obj <- ScaleData(obj, assay = "Spatial", features = rownames(obj))
```

# Top cluster markers heatmap (Fig 2c)
```{r}
DoHeatmap(
  obj,
  features = unique(markers_top10_pct10$gene),
```

# Spatial plots by cluster (Fig 2f)
```{r}
coords_df <- bind_rows(lapply(Images(obj), function(img) {
  tc <- GetTissueCoordinates(obj, image = img) %>% as.data.frame()
  if ("in_tissue" %in% colnames(tc)) tc <- tc[tc$in_tissue == 1, , drop = FALSE]
  tc %>% transmute(barcode = cell, image_name = img, x = x, y = y)
}))

plot_df <- coords_df %>%
  left_join(
    obj@meta.data %>%
      rownames_to_column("barcode") %>%
      transmute(barcode, cluster = factor(as.character(seurat_clusters), levels = as.character(0:12))),
    by = "barcode"
  ) %>%
  group_by(image_name) %>%
  mutate(
    x = (x - min(x, na.rm = TRUE)) / (max(x, na.rm = TRUE) - min(x, na.rm = TRUE) + 1e-9),
    y = (y - min(y, na.rm = TRUE)) / (max(y, na.rm = TRUE) - min(y, na.rm = TRUE) + 1e-9),
    x_rot = x,
    y_rot = 1 - y
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(image_name = factor(image_name, levels = c(
    "CRC_03_Normal", "CRC_06_Normal", "CRC_08_Normal",
    "CRC_03_Tumor",  "CRC_07_Tumor",  "CRC_08_Tumor"
  )))

ggplot(plot_df, aes(x_rot, y_rot)) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = cluster), shape = 21, size = 1.2, stroke = 0.1, color = "grey15") +
  coord_fixed() +
  facet_wrap(~ image_name, nrow = 2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cluster_colors) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    strip.text      = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing   = unit(0.25, "lines"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
```

# Add assays containing Group/Probe log1p counts
```{r}
expr <- GetAssayData(obj, assay = "Spatial", layer = "counts")

bact_probes_all <- intersect(
  probe_map$Name[!grepl("GAPDH", probe_map$Name, ignore.case = TRUE)], 
  rownames(expr)
)
probe_by_group <- split(
  intersect(probe_map$Name, rownames(expr)), 
  make.names(probe_map$List[match(intersect(probe_map$Name, rownames(expr)), probe_map$Name)])
)

# Groups-level log1p counts for plotting
group_counts <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(probe_by_group), function(g) {
  Matrix::colSums(expr[probe_by_group[[g]], , drop = FALSE])
}))
rownames(group_counts) <- names(probe_by_group)

bacteria_feats <- setdiff(rownames(group_counts), make.names("GAPDH"))
group_counts <- rbind(group_counts, AllBacteria = Matrix::colSums(group_counts[bacteria_feats, ]))

obj[["Groups_log"]] <- CreateAssayObject(counts = group_counts)
obj[["Groups_log"]] <- SetAssayData(obj[["Groups_log"]], layer = "data", new.data = log1p(group_counts))

# Individual bacteria probe log1p counts for plotting 
bact_counts <- expr[bact_probes_all, ]
obj[["Probes_log"]] <- CreateAssayObject(counts = bact_counts)
obj[["Probes_log"]] <- SetAssayData(obj[["Probes_log"]], layer = "data", new.data = log1p(bact_counts))
```

```{r}
saveRDS(obj, file = file.path(out_dir, "CRC_all_integrated.rds"))
```
